Debe ser de las peores YPF del país, no te cobran con ningún medio electrónico y no te cargan los puntos serviclub, lo cual te avisan cuando ya cargaste. Adentro en la tienda desbordados, poco personal.

(Translated by Google)
This must be one of the worst YPF stations in the country. They don't accept electronic payments and they don't credit your Serviclub points; they only tell you after you've already filled up. Inside, the store is overcrowded and understaffed.
